steps.title: 1. Call or enquire
steps.copy: Talk to our manager about what you need — honestly, including whether Oakfield is the right fit at all.

steps.title: 2. Visit the home
steps.copy: Come for a look around and stay for lunch. Bring the person who may live here — their impression matters most.

steps.title: 3. Assessment
steps.copy: We visit you (at home or in hospital) to understand care needs, routines and preferences before anything is agreed.

steps.title: 4. Moving in
steps.copy: A settled, unhurried move — the room ready, favourite things in place, and family welcome from day one.

faqs.q: What does care at Oakfield House cost?
faqs.a: Fees start from £1,350 per week for residential care, depending on the level of support needed. That figure includes everything day to day — meals, activities, laundry — with no surprise extras. We publish our fees because families deserve to plan with real numbers.
Whenever suits you — there are no set visiting hours. Grandchildren, dogs and birthday cakes are all welcome. We just ask you avoid mealtimes for a resident's first fortnight while they settle.
Yes. We have two companion rooms, and where needs differ we build a care plan around each person while keeping them together.

faqs.q: What happens if care needs change?
faqs.a: Care plans are reviewed monthly, and with families straight away when something changes. Because we provide residential, dementia and respite care under one roof, most changes don't mean moving home.
